fieldborders: agricultural field boundaries from Sentinel-2 time series

Source: R/fieldborders-package.R
fieldborders-package.Rd

The package delineates agricultural fields from image time series with the temporal boundary contrast (TBC) method and, optionally, fuses its maps with the class probabilities of deep segmentation models.

Details

A typical workflow:

  1. build a time-series stack: fb_s2_monthly() (download) or fb_stack() / fb_read_stack() (own data);

  2. get a model: fb_model_pretrained(), or train one with reference polygons (fb_reference(), fb_rank_contrast(), fb_train());

  3. compute edge and cropland maps: fb_tbc_maps(); optionally fuse them with deep-model probabilities (fb_prue_predict(), fb_fuse());

  4. delineate fields: fb_delineate(), fb_polygons(), or all in one step with fb_fields();

  5. assess accuracy: fb_evaluate(), fb_accuracy(), fb_bootstrap();

  6. map the results: fb_plot_rgb(), fb_plot_maps(), fb_plot_fields().
